description: This file contains functions related to migrating LED sysfs configurations and applying configuration changes in an OpenWRT system. It defines functions to update sysfs paths, remove device name prefixes, and apply migration commands.

methods.name: migrate_led_sysfs
methods.description: Updates the sysfs path for a specified configuration entry, replacing old prefixes with new ones.

methods.name: remove_devicename_led_sysfs
methods.description: Removes the device name prefix from the sysfs path if certain conditions are met.

methods.name: migrate_leds
methods.description: Loads system configuration and applies the 'migrate_led_sysfs' function to each 'led' configuration.

methods.name: remove_devicename_leds
methods.description: Loads system configuration and applies the 'remove_devicename_led_sysfs' function to each 'led' configuration.

methods.name: migrations_apply
methods.description: Applies configuration changes within a specified realm if there are pending changes.
